overview: City Councilor Justin Tseng discussed his re-election campaign, focusing on housing affordability, the intersection of national and local policy, and upcoming investments in Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Introduction and local dining
items.summary: Justin Tseng introduced himself and recommended Starby BBQ as a local dining option.

items.title: Campaign reflections and record
items.summary: Councilor Tseng reviewed his legislative record, highlighting school funding, infrastructure improvements, and increased transparency at City Hall.

items.title: National and local policy intersection
items.summary: Tseng explained how federal policies regarding immigration and science funding necessitate local protections like the Welcoming City Ordinance.

items.title: Divestment and council representation
items.summary: The candidate addressed the council's work on a divestment ordinance and the role of local government in responding to resident concerns when federal and state institutions fail.

items.title: Zoning and affordable housing proposals
items.summary: Tseng proposed housing reforms including updated linkage fees, tree protection ordinances, and a municipal office of housing stability.

items.title: School enrollment and high school project
items.summary: Tseng discussed school overcrowding issues and the upcoming council vote required to advance the Medford High School reconstruction project.

items.title: Progressive leadership team
items.summary: Tseng concluded by emphasizing the importance of a collaborative progressive team on the City Council and highlighting specific colleagues' contributions.
